otodus_megalodon.look: A colossal, streamlined shark with a robust, broad head and a massive jaw capable of opening over three meters wide. Its skin is a smooth, greyish-brown dorsal surface fading to a lighter ventral side, typical of deep-sea predators. The body is thick and muscular, suggesting immense power, with large pectoral fins for stability. The eyes are small and dark, set back on the head, while the gill slits are prominent. The overall appearance is that of a heavy, powerful apex predator, distinct from the more slender modern sharks.
